'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Chris Wirs DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirs]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title There you go Joe; HUNTDOWN. Typed list with handwritten shield swaps. Player field also Wirth; kept Wirs.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Wirs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
